claims.text: The resort is on the West Coast Road at Anse Louis on Mahe Island, Seychelles.

findings.quote: Anantara Maia Seychelles Villas is located on the West Coast Road, Anse Louis, Mahe Island, Seychelles.

claims.text: The resort sits on a petite peninsula on Mahe's southwest coast, separating Anse Louis and Anse Boileau.

findings.quote: Along the southwest coast of the Seychelles main island of Mahé, the hillside resort occupies 30 acres, situated on a dreamy, petite peninsula separating Anse Louis and Anse Boileau.

claims.text: The resort's private villas edge porcelain sands and are framed by thirty acres of forest.

findings.quote: Embrace restorative luxury in private villas edging porcelain sands framed by thirty acres of forest.

claims.text: Villas are located either on the beach or on the hilltop, overlooking the secluded coastline and the Indian Ocean.

findings.quote: There are 30 villas in total, located either on the beach or the hilltop, with a unique perspective of the secluded coastline and sparkling Indian Ocean.

claims.text: The villas have thatched roofs and are all identical in size and layout; they differ in their views.

findings.quote: All 30 thatched-roof villas are identical in terms of size and layout
Where the villas differ are the views

claims.text: Peninsula Ocean View Pool Villas sit on the edge of the peninsula with open views of the Indian Ocean.

findings.quote: Three Peninsula Ocean View Pool Villas are perfectly located on the edge of the peninsula, offering the experience of ultimate privacy and open views of the Indian Ocean.

claims.text: Spa therapists come from Thailand and Bali.

findings.quote: Therapists hail from Thailand and Bali

claims.text: The resort offers yoga and wellness sessions, Technogym workouts and a padel court.

findings.quote: Yoga and wellness sessions
Technogym workouts
Padel court

claims.text: There is no kids' club, but the Very Important Kids Program includes supervised water sports, cooking and painting, and the spa has a kids' wellness menu.

findings.quote: While there’s no Kid’s Club per se, the resort offers a Very Important Kids Program, tailor made to include water sports, cooking, painting and more, all supervised by the recreation team.
Another standout of this spa is a kids’ wellness menu

claims.text: With the Dining by Design concept, guests can choose from a range of gourmet cuisines with a choice of backdrops.

findings.quote: Explore a range of gourmet cuisines with a choice of exquisite backdrops with our exclusive Dining by Design concept.

claims.text: Scuba diving can be organised with a nearby preferred dive centre, and the resort can arrange day trips to neighbouring islands.

findings.quote: Scuba diving can be organised with our nearby preferred dive centre.
The resort can also arrange day trips to neighboring islands.

claims.text: Guests can walk to Anse Boileau, a small fishing village a few minutes away with a local market and a Catholic church.

findings.quote: can walk to Anse Boileau, a small fishing village a few minutes away, with a local market and a Catholic church

claims.text: The villas were designed by Bill Bensley and combine rustic hammered copper with elegant soft furnishings.

findings.quote: Unwind in Bill Bensley-designed villas that combine rustic elements of hammered copper with elegant soft furnishings.

claims.text: Each villa has a private infinity pool, a sun deck and an outdoor sunken bathtub.

findings.quote: Have a relaxing swim in your infinity pool while admiring the abundance of this natural paradise.
Sun deck in each room
Outdoor sunken bath tub in each villa

claims.text: Each villa has a dedicated Villa Host, assigned to that villa only and reachable 24/7 by WhatsApp.

findings.quote: A dedicated Villa Host is assigned exclusively to each villa
this host is your first point of contact, available 24/7 by What’s App

claims.text: The Anantara Spa has open-air treatment pavilions and offers The Maia Signature Massage, a long-stroke, stretch-heavy treatment developed for the resort.

findings.quote: Anantara Spa with open air pavilions
One treatment to try is The Maia Signature Massage, which is a long-stroke and stretch-heavy treatment developed specifically for the resort.

claims.text: With the Marine Conservation Society Seychelles, the resort runs a long-term sea turtle monitoring program on Anse Louis beach, a nesting beach for Hawksbill and Green turtles.

findings.quote: In partnership with NGO Marine Conservation Society Seychelles (MCSS), Anantara Maia conducts quarterly beach clean ups
has developed a long-term sea turtle monitoring program on Anse Louis beach, a nesting beach for Hawksbill and Green turtles.

claims.text: Hilltop villas have more sweeping ocean views, while those nearer sea level see more foliage and less water but have direct beach access.

findings.quote: some are situated hilltop, lending to more sweeping ocean vistas, while those closer to sea level peninsula see a bit less water and more foliage but offer a comparative advantage of direct beach access

claims.text: Room rates are subject to a sustainable environmental fee per villa per night, invoiced separately.

findings.quote: All room rates are subject to a sustainable environmental fee of EUR 10 per villa per night, which will be invoiced separately

claims.text: The resort is approximately 35 minutes from the international airport by car, depending on traffic.

findings.quote: Our resort is approximately 35 minutes from the international airport by car, depending on traffic.
